name: @ternix/desktop
description: Ternix desktop client (Electron): vaults, sharing and SSH terminals
author: Ternix

scripts.dist:dir: corepack pnpm run build:deps && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: corepack pnpm run build:deps && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: corepack pnpm run build:deps && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:e2e: corepack pnpm run build:deps && TERNIX_E2E_BUILD=1 electron-vite build && TERNIX_E2E_BUILD=1 node scripts/package-e2e.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
